note: Built from the official trophy descriptions alone: which story chapters and missions, which collectibles and counts, in what order. No step here claims a location or method the official descriptions do not give; where a place is not pinned down, the trophy's own guide says so.

stages.advice: Play Chapters 1–4 in order and finish each named mission as it appears: Gone Fishing, Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory. Chapter trophies pop when a chapter closes. While you are at VCIA for the takedown, remember the unscheduled-departure trophy — the airport holds more than one moment.
stages.title: 1 · Play the story — Chapters 1 to 4
stages.why: Every chapter trophy and every named-mission trophy is tied to story progress, and the one-time moments only happen once. Clear them as they come; do not leave the story for later.

stages.advice: Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida, then play the final mission. Before the finale, check the Missables page: after the credits roll, a one-time story moment may not come back.
stages.title: 2 · Finish the story — finale and contact strands
stages.why: The finale is the last story beat, and the contact finales are side-story missions that end with a single mission each. Do them before the credits, not after.

stages.advice: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, win 20 different races, beat Cal in a fishing challenge, finish an arcade game, hunt Bret's unique animal, bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley, and have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Stunts (250) and challenges (50) build up across all of it, and sampling every activity type earns Master of None.
stages.title: 3 · Activities circuit — races, range, fishing, bowling
stages.why: Activities are repeatable and have no deadline, so they are the safe middle of the roadmap: skill-based, countable, and good to build up while the story is still fresh.

stages.advice: Meditate at all 18 spots, complete 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, and explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Buy the 8 garage properties as money allows — they store the vehicles you discover. Do this stage while travelling: every trip across the map can tick off a spot, a location or a vehicle.
stages.title: 4 · Collectibles and exploration — cards, WAiNK, vehicles, areas
stages.why: Collectibles are pure volume with fixed counts, so they are a clean grind once the story is done. Pair them with exploring the whole state.

stages.advice: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level, rob a jewelry store undetected, rob 5 bank vaults and escape, rob an armored truck and escape, and rob an illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 across all shops, and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
stages.title: 5 · Money and heists — robberies, vaults, laundering
stages.why: Money trophies feed each other: robberies produce Marked Bills, laundering turns them into clean cash, and clean cash buys garages and pays for $100,000 of shopping.

stages.advice: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape, take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, deal with the Rhinos, and smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The vague hidden trophies — a partnership with mass appeal, choices made, second time's the charm, what the hell just happened — come from playing, not planning; the melee drive-by is the one to set up on purpose.
stages.title: 6 · Combat and chaos — wanted levels, Combat Focus, odd moments
stages.why: These need specific situations, not a checklist, so set them up deliberately: a partner beside you, a crowd of enemies, a moving car.

stages.advice: With every other trophy earned, check what the game's own 100% counter still shows missing and mop it up. Attain 100% completion and the platinum — Vice Got a Price! — pops with it.
stages.title: 7 · 100% completion, then the platinum
stages.why: 100% completion is the gold trophy that gathers everything: story, side missions, activities and collectibles. It is last because it needs all of them.
